_provenance: Inputs of the site figures that are not headline tables. Rendered into website/benchmarks.json by docs/benchmarks/render.py.

true_fdp._note: Entrapment-estimated true FDP at nominal 1%, range over Percolator seeds / database realisations (timsTOF: per-run means over six shuffle draws). Values as in docs/benchmarks section 2.1.

knockoff._note: Variant PSMs reported, true FDP vs donor genotypes (PXD022787, 69 runs). README 'Variant calls checked against knockoffs'.

tmt_interference._note: Knockout-channel interference, median ratio, lower is better; PXD017803, 2026-11-05 at 0cfa03cc. docs/benchmarks/README.md TMT section. 34-91 knockout PSMs behind each value.

retrieval._note: README 'How it works' (phospho 164 s instead of 99 min) and glyco memory note (20.0 GB in-RAM -> 4.5 GB out-of-core, identical output).

protein_fdp._note: Astral, three peptide-level shuffled entrapments, protein groups (DOCS.md section on protein inference).

glyco_pxd065680._note: PXD065680 / JPST003908, HCD F03 file; andes main @ 24cec490, Percolator 3.7.1, 2026-10-28. Paper: Sakaue et al., J Proteome Res 2026, doi 10.1021/acs.jproteome.6c00345 (counts from the accepted manuscript; each tool's own FDR rule). Source: internal glyco benchmark artifact.

dia_astral._note: ProteoBench LFQ_Astral_DIA_15min_50ng raw01/raw02 with OpenDIA's PAIRLIB entrapment library and metric (docs/benchmarks/dia). Precursors at an entrapment true FDP of 1%. andes --dia --rescore --predict rt,ms2: mean of Percolator 3.7.1 seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 7 (lo/hi: seed range), 2026-11-17. DIA-NN 2.2 (own decoys) and OpenDIA arm E from OpenDIA's RESULT.md.
